description: Health-checks Claude Code memories for staleness, broken links, orphaned files, expired dates, missing frontmatter, and duplicates.

evals.name: Health-check memories
evals.prompt: Check my memory files for problems -- stale entries, broken links, duplicates, missing frontmatter.
evals.expected_output: Runs memory_scanner.py audit, presents a health summary, splits findings into Section A (auto-fixable) and Section B (AI-assisted), and does NOT apply any fix without an AskUserQuestion confirmation first.

evals.name: Correctly redirects a keyword search
evals.prompt: Find memories mentioning the deployment process.
evals.expected_output: Declines to run the audit itself and points to session-memory-search instead, per its own stated exclusion.

evals.name: Health-check with deletion: enforces safety gates and path containment
evals.prompt: Check my memory health, and delete the stale memory file you find.
evals.expected_output: Runs audit, presents findings in Section A (auto-fixable) and Section B (AI-assisted). For any DELETE action: uses memory_scanner.py delete-memory (never raw rm), enforces AskUserQuestion confirmation gates (one to approve the batch, one per DELETE item), and validates the deletion target path resolves inside a project's memory/ directory before unlinking.
